stem.text: Which force-extension graph shows plastic deformation of a sample of material?

A.alt: Force against extension: straight line through the origin, with loading and unloading arrows on the same line

B.alt: Force against extension: curve from the origin that bends over, with loading and unloading arrows on the same curve

C.alt: Force against extension: two different curves forming a loop, loading on the upper curve and unloading on the lower curve, both returning to the origin

D.alt: Force against extension: loading curve from the origin, then unloading line parallel to the loading line that ends at a positive extension when force is zero
